respuesta.historial_usuario: Hi! I'm building a client for zenith-keeper 1.1.6. Right now I'm working on the due-date reporting screens of our warehouse dashboard.
respuesta.historial_asistente: Sounds good. Ask me anything you need about the API for those due-date screens and I'll look it up.
respuesta.pregunta: For the endpoint that lists batch stock by due date filtered by category, what responses can I get back, and what does the body look like when the call succeeds?
respuesta.respuesta:
That endpoint is GET /api/v1/fresh-products/due-date/list{quantityOfDays}/{category}/{sort}. It returns batch stock sorted by due date and filtered by category [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L256-L261]. Two responses are documented: a 200 (OK) whose application/json body uses the BatchStockDTOResp schema, and a 404 (Not Found) whose application/json body is a generic object [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L278-L290].

On success, BatchStockDTOResp holds a single property, batchStock, which is an array of BatchDueDateDTOResp items [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L510-L516]. Each item has these fields: batchNumber (object, format Long), productId (string), productTypeId (string), dueDate (object, format LocalDate), currentQuantity (integer) and section (string) [zenith-keeper/1.1.6/specs/swagger.yaml:L517-L533].
